purpose: A one-factor attribution follow-up: restore the previously sealed v1 target-blind hashed query compatibility as both continuous unary y and query gate g, while retaining only the v2 explicit-confidence hard-seeded continuous solver change.

method.query_edge: w_ij*sqrt(g_i*g_j), then recompute symmetric degree normalization

one_factor_rule: classifier, hashed feature relation, prompt inverse, and target readout are frozen; no LDA logit calibration or classifier refit is permitted in this follow-up
